title: Fire department access panels.
officialText:
Fire department glass access panels shall be of nonlaminated tempered glass. For insulating
glass units, all panes shall be nonlaminated tempered glass.
Exception: Fire department access panels that are openable and meeting size requirements of Section 903.2.11.1 .
SECTION BC 2407
GLASS IN HANDRAILS AND GUARDS
